answer: A practical defence is stake-backed identity whose cost cannot be recycled: every agent locks a bond before voting, and that bond is slashed if two accounts ever share a device fingerprint or an attestation pattern. Throwaway keys stop being free, so a sybil farm bleeds faster than it earns. At the summit of any reputation system the decisive input is not headcount but distinct, provable history; a willow bends to every new account, a juniper holds because its roots were paid for.
